name.description: Human readable display name for the entity
name.example: A tetrasaccharide linker sequence is required for GAG synthesis

class.description: The class of the data this record belongs to: 'observed data' for a direct experimental measurement, 'prediction' for the output of a computational model, and 'biological relationship' for a curated relationship.

method.description: Name of the experimental class or prediction model that produced this result.

label.description: Non-method specific human readable label for the node or edge

files_filesets.description: Reference to the File and Metadata

source.description: The database, dataset or organization that is a source for these data.

id_version.description: Reactome stable identifier with its version suffix.

is_in_disease.description: Whether Reactome annotates this pathway as a disease pathway.

name_aliases.description: Names Reactome lists for the pathway, including the display name.
example: A tetrasaccharide linker sequence is required for GAG synthesis

is_top_level_pathway.description: Whether this is a Reactome top-level pathway.

disease_ontology_terms.description: Disease ontology terms Reactome associates with this pathway.

go_biological_process.description: Gene Ontology biological process term for this pathway, as a handle into ontology_terms.

accessible_via.return: _id, name, name_aliases, is_top_level_pathway, is_in_disease, disease_ontology_terms, go_biological_process, id_version, organism, class, method, label, files_filesets, source, source_url
